reason: A client-side DSH web plugin that adds a one-click input-bar control for entering and exiting Plan mode through the official /plan command.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页输入栏添加一键进入或退出计划模式的按钮，并实时显示计划状态。
summaries.en: Adds a one-click button to the DSH web input bar for entering or exiting Plan mode through the official command.

capabilities: Adds a client-side button to the DSH web input bar
Executes the official /plan command when clicked
Reflects plan-mode state and disables the button during pending switches
